Tons of flavor. Interesting and unique worlds with actual characters. One critique is that for the huge amount of (hand crafted) loot the game offers, there's no simple way to sort them. A search function or category tags would be a nice quality of life improvement, especially for relic mods. Also, loadouts would be good.

Edit: they added loadouts
Edit 2: Came back after a while to play with a friend and they added items tags and reworked the relic fragment menu to be more user friendly. I even found new items and encounters in my little bit of time playing. So I guess I have nothing left to complain about.
Perfectly balanced, as all things should be.

I loved the first game, but this is just.... wtf.... 

1 - Spawn mechanic can now allow enemies to spawn in areas you've already cleared, and can just start spawn spamming whenever it wants.
2 - Movement for the player is just clunky AF, and the AI gets several movement powers that out-step the player's. 
3 - Stamina depletes entirely too fast. Dodging once consumes roughly 25% of your stamina without modifiers, but enemies can and will spam attacks that will deplete your stamina, then continue. Not balanced at all. 
4 - They make both bullet sponge and damage cannon the source of difficulty. Meaning you can't dodge the attacks effectively, but you also have to deal with a massive health bar for the enemy, and the fact that even standard enemies take double digit percentages out of your health every hit.
5 - Enemies can delay or expidite their attacks at random. This negates any timing capability. This is also very problematic when you have more than 1 opponent, and given the spawn mechanics already mentioned, this is a HUGE problem. 
6 - Controls are not always responsive. There have been many times in my play throughs where the gun doesn't fire when I click left mouse, or doesn't launch the melee attack when I click, or the character doesn't dodge when I hit space.
7 - Stun lock is a terrible thing in this game. If you get hit, you're stunned for at least a few seconds, even by common mobs, but there's no stun lock mechanic for the player to leverage. 
8 - Using the relic to heal yourself takes several seconds without modifications to the build, and becomes an issue when you need the heals most.

In short, the devs seem to have lost sight of what made this game fun at first, and just thought they'd jump on the Souls band-wagon, and I hate it. I'm too far into this to get a refund, so I'm trying to find some joy in it, but FFS... It isn't easy.  This is so far from balanced it may as well be a ton of iron on the left, and a single gold coin on the right.

IF you buy it, get it on sale. You'll feel cheated out of your money otherwise, unless you're a masochist...

Money was not spent worth it. First Remnant had more content, more weapons, more armour, more interesting puzzles and bosses, and was bigger, for 50$, Remnant II is very bad game, the only worth it was DLC "The Forgotten Kingdom".
